description: This file defines a mock implementation of the IGraph interface within the MockGraphingImpl namespace. It provides a mock Graph class with methods for initialization, retrieving options, variables, renderer, and analyzer, primarily used for testing purposes.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IGraph interface used for testing graph-related functionalities.

methods.name: Graph
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the graph renderer.

methods.name: TryInitialize
methods.description: Attempts to initialize the graph with an optional expression, returning a vector of equations or nullopt.

methods.name: GetInitializationError
methods.description: Returns the HRESULT indicating the initialization status.

methods.name: GetVariables
methods.description: Returns the list of variables used in the graph.

methods.name: SetArgValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a variable by name (stub implementation).

methods.name: GetRenderer
methods.description: Returns the renderer associated with the graph.

methods.name: TryResetSelection
methods.description: Attempts to reset the selection, always returns true.

methods.name: GetAnalyzer
methods.description: Returns the graph analyzer, null in this mock implementation.
